text: . India’s para archers Sheetal Devi and Toman Kumar clinched the compound mixed team gold at the Asian Para Games, beating Indonesia’s Teodora Audi Ayudia Ferelly and Ken Swagumilang 151-148 in a one-sided final in Aichi-Nagoya today. The top-seeded Indians, who set a new world record in the qualification round, consistently hit the target to build and maintain their lead throughout the clash.India edged ahead 38-37 in the opening end before extending their advantage to four points at 77-73 in the second, dropping just one point in the process. Earlier, Suvarna Raj bagged a gold medal by winning the women’s F-54 discus throw event. In para-archery, Swati Chaudhary secured silver in the women’s W-1 category.In para table tennis, Bhavina Patel and Shubham Wadhwa confirmed a medal in mixed doubles XD7 after defeating Japan’s Kimie Bessho and Masanori Uno in straight games, 11-9, 11-3, and 11-6. They will face a South Korean pair in the semifinals. Meanwhile, Dattaprasad Chougule and Savita lost 2-3 to the Philippines in the XD17 quarterfinals despite winning the first two games.India also secured several bronze medals in para-badminton. Manisha Ramadass and Pramod Bhagat lost their mixed doubles semifinal to Indonesia’s Leani Ratri Oktila and Hikmat Ramadani. Sanjana Kumari won bronze in women’s singles SL3, while Suhas Yathiraj and Abhijeet Sakhuja secured bronze in men’s singles SL4. Krishna Nagar and Nithya Sre also claimed bronze in mixed doubles SH6.

. Union Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan will launch the nationwide ‘Khet Bachao Abhiyan-Rabi 2026’ from Karnal in Haryana today. The campaign will continue until November 30. The initiative is aimed at promoting sustainable agriculture, improving soil health and encouraging the judicious use of agricultural resources.The campaign aims to create awareness among farmers about the balanced and judicious use of fertilisers and other agricultural inputs based on soil testing. It will promote crop diversification through oilseed, pulse and horticulture missions, encourage the effective utilisation of fallow fields after paddy harvesting and promote proper crop residue management.The campaign will also focus on training farmers in the appropriate use of organic and bio-based agricultural products and promoting natural farming through awareness programmes, training sessions and field demonstrations. As part of the campaign, farmers’ conferences, Kisan Chaupals, training sessions and field demonstrations will be organised at the state, district, block and Gram Panchayat levels. Agriculture departments, Krishi Vigyan Kendras, ICAR institutes and agricultural universities will work together to ensure wider participation to strengthen public outreach.Awareness about the campaign will also be spread through local-language information materials, Radio, Doordarshan, social media and other information, education and communication activities. Through the ‘Khet Bachao Abhiyan’, the Government seeks to strengthen soil and water conservation, promote efficient and cost-effective farming practices, improve agricultural sustainability and contribute to the long-term prosperity of farmers and the vision of Viksit Bharat.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has completed 25 years in public service, a journey defined by the mantra of Jan Seva Se Desh Seva, and a relentless commitment that continues. Guided by this vision for Seva and Sushasan, the Government has been ceaselessly working towards achieving the goal of a Viksit Bharat by 2047. Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives. Today, in our special series, we bring you an instance of how this vision has been translated into action through initiatives like the International Solar Alliance.India and France had jointly launched the International Solar Alliance in November 2015 during the COP21 climate conference. The global intergovernmental organisation is dedicated to accelerating the deployment of solar energy as a pathway to energy access, energy security, and sustainable development. ISA was created to mobilise collective action against climate change through the widespread adoption of solar energy solutions.  Today, ISA has evolved into a global platform for international cooperation on solar energy, with 129 countries currently registered as members. Co-chairing the launch of International Solar Alliance during COP21 in Paris, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said that the alliance focuses on making solar energy cheap, reliable, and widely accessible by driving research and development, streamlining regulations, building infrastructure, and unlocking new financing models to draw investment.Talking to Akashvani News, Director General of International Solar Alliance Ashish Khanna said that ISA signifies the strength of the vision of  Prime Minister Modi and showcases India’s ability to the global south, bringing together countries for cleaner energy, livelihood and energy security.The alliance represents a transformative movement towards a sustainable energy future. With India leading this initiative, ISA not only aims to enhance energy access and security but focuses to significantly reduce carbon emissions globally.

A delegation of Indian companies is showcasing innovative solutions in water treatment, environmental technologies and sustainability as part of the Bharat Pavilion at WETEX 2026, being held at the Dubai World Trade Centre from 20-22 October. WETEX, organised by the Dubai Electricity and Water Authority, is one of the region’s leading exhibitions focusing on water, energy, technology and the environment.The participating companies are presenting a range of technologies and solutions, including water treatment plants, sewage treatment systems, membranes, pumps, filtration components, underwater robots, artificial intelligence-powered facility intelligence systems, and bioculture and odour control solutions.Their offerings also cover energy, automation, analytical and process applications, and environmental sustainability. Indian participants highlighted India’s growing capabilities in indigenous water quality monitoring technologies, with Make in India products offering innovative solutions for global markets.First-time international exhibitors expressed optimism about expanding into the Gulf market, citing the quality and competitiveness of Indian water treatment solutions and WETEX as a platform to connect with global industry players.The Bharat Pavilion has been organised by the Services Export Promotion Council, SEPC, under India’s Ministry of Commerce and Industry, to promote Indian services exports and strengthen business ties with the Gulf region and other international markets. It provides a common platform for Indian companies to connect with international buyers, industry leaders and potential partners, and explore opportunities for distribution agreements, joint ventures and project collaborations.The initiative is supported under the Government of India’s Export Promotion Mission, which provides assistance to eligible Indian exhibitors towards participation costs. SEPC is also facilitating a visitor delegation to help Indian businesses explore opportunities in the Gulf market. The Indian participation at WETEX 2026 underscores the country’s growing capabilities in water and environmental technologies and its commitment to expanding services exports through international partnerships.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has completed 25 years in public service, a journey defined by the mantra of Jan Seva Se Desh Seva, and a relentless commitment that continues. Guided by this vision for Seva and Sushasan, the Government has been ceaselessly working towards achieving the goal of a Viksit Bharat by 2047. Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives. Today, in our special series, we bring you an instance of how this vision has been translated into action through initiatives like the PM Jan Dhan Yojana.Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana has emerged as a cornerstone of India’s financial inclusion journey since its launch in 2014 by Prime Minister Narendra Modi. With over 59 crore Jan Dhan accounts, the scheme has grown into the largest financial inclusion initiative in the world. The scheme has provided universal banking access for every household and has become the foundation for direct benefit transfers. It has helped save almost 3.5 lakh crore rupees by plugging leakages in welfare delivery.Addressing the centenary celebrations of Shri Ram College of Commerce in New Delhi last month, Prime Minister Narendra Modi had said that Jan Dhan Yojana has transformed India’s banking landscape and today almost every family in the country is connected to the banking system.As the world’s largest financial inclusion initiative, the scheme is redefining access to banking for millions of underprivileged citizens. The Jan Dhan account holder can avail overdraft facility of up to ten thousand rupees per household.

. At least 10 people were killed and 44 others injured after a speeding bus overturned following a collision with a road divider on the Indus Highway in Pakistan’s Punjab province today.The accident occurred around 5:45 am local time in the Bangla Hidayat area of Rojhan tehsil in Rajanpur district, according to local media reports citing rescue authorities.According to Dawn, the deceased included seven men, two women and a girl.More than 38 injured passengers were being treated at Rajanpur District Headquarters Hospital, while six seriously injured people were shifted to hospitals in Dera Ghazi Khan and Rahim Yar Khan.

. Benchmark domestic equity indices ended lower today, extending their losses for a second consecutive session.The Sensex dropped 143 points, or 0.19 per cent to close at 73 thousand 710. The Nifty declined 78 points, or 0.34 per cent to settle at 22 thousand 811.In the broader market on the National Stock Exchange, the Midcap 100 index shed 1.6 per cent, while the Smallcap 100 index plunged 2.4 per cent.

. French President Emmanuel Macron has criticised foreign leaders for their remarks on recent unrest in France, accusing them of exploiting the situation for political gains. Speaking to the media during his three-day visit to Qatar, Macron condemned what he described as “stupid comments” by foreign leaders who, he said, were using France’s domestic turmoil to advance their political agendas. Macron also rejected claims of direct foreign interference in the unrest while expressing concern over the spread of misinformation, including artificial intelligence-generated images depicting incidents that had not taken place.

. The Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) held a meeting with Delhi government agencies yesterday to review dust pollution issues and strengthen coordinated action for effective air pollution mitigation in Delhi in the coming days. The review meeting was held under the Co-Chairmanship of Chairperson of CAQM Rajesh Verma. The Commission emphasised that all concerned agencies must strictly comply with its Statutory Directions issued from time to time and ensure their strict implementation.During the meeting, the Municipal Corporation of Delhi was specifically directed to strengthen dust mitigation measures on roads and open areas under its jurisdiction. Meanwhile, the Delhi Pollution Control Committee was directed to ensure close coordination among all concerned agencies for effective air pollution mitigation. The committee was also directed to take prompt action on identified dust pollution issues, take strict action against the concerned officials and project implementing agencies in cases of violation and ensure compliance.

. The US Postal Service (USPS) has released a Diwali commemorative postage stamp featuring a rangoli design by Houston-based Indian artist Sangita Bhutada. The stamp was launched yesterday at a ceremony at the Indian Embassy in Washington in the presence of India’s Ambassador to the US Vinay Mohan Kwatra and USPS Senior Vice President Shibani Gambhir. Bhutada, who has practised the traditional art of rangoli for nearly 30 years, said the design took around 10 days to complete.The eight-foot rangoli features bright shades of blue, orange, green, red and white. This is the second time the USPS has issued a stamp to mark Diwali. The first was released in 2016.

. Russian President Vladimir Putin agreed today to resume trilateral negotiations with Washington and Kyiv on ending the war in Ukraine.A Kremlin official said that Russian President’s foreign affairs adviser Yuri Ushakov told reporters in Moscow after a meeting between Mr. Putin and US President Donald Trump’s envoy Steve Witkoff that the Russian leader has agreed in principle to resume the trilateral talks after November 10.The meeting was held in St. Petersburg today, where Mr. Putin and Mr. Witkoff discussed several issues, including the Ukrainian peace process. They also discussed the situation in the Persian Gulf and the diesel deal.Earlier, speaking to reporters in the Oval Office, Mr. Trump had warned Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky that delaying a peace agreement with Russia could leave Ukraine in an increasingly difficult position.

. The United Nations has warned that a powerful El Niño could trigger major economic shocks worldwide, with Latin America, Africa, Asia and the Pacific facing extreme heat, droughts and floods. Speaking at a news conference in Geneva, UN Under-Secretary-General Tom Fletcher described the phenomenon as a ‘wrecking ball’ and called for urgent global action to minimise its impact.Mr Fletcher said the next two weeks would be critical for preparedness and urged governments, civil society, businesses and international partners to mobilise resources and keep disaster response capacities on standby. He warned that the consequences could extend beyond affected regions, fuelling conflict, displacement and migration.World Meteorological Organisation chief Celeste Saulo said El Niño could reach unprecedented strength towards the end of this year, with its effects continuing long afterwards. She cautioned that Southeast Asia could face higher temperatures, reduced rainfall, increased wildfire and smoke hazards, and growing pressure on agriculture and water supplies.

. Prachi Tokas outpunched Samoa’s Kealey Perez to reach the women’s 80kg-plus semifinals and assure India of its first medal at the U-19 World Boxing Championships in Budva, Montenegro. In the quarterfinal, Asian U-19 silver medallist Prachi dominated all three rounds against Perez, who had won gold at the U-19 World Boxing Futures Cup in Bangkok earlier this year. Prachi will face Russia’s Samira Itonieva in the semifinals.Meanwhile, Harshika and Lakshu registered contrasting wins in their pre-quarterfinal bouts to move within one victory of assuring themselves of medals. Harshika defeated Australia’s Tiana Rew 4:0 in the women’s 65kg category, while Lakshu edged Turkey’s Buse Nur Yahan 3:2 in the women’s 70kg category.In the men’s 90kg category, Dhruv went down 0:3 to Poland’s Aleksander Sikora.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has completed 25 years in public service, a journey defined by the mantra of Jan Seva Se Desh Seva, and a relentless commitment that continues. Guided by this vision for Seva and Sushasan, the Government has been ceaselessly working towards achieving the goal of a Viksit Bharat by 2047. Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives. Today, in our special series, we bring you an instance of how this vision has been translated into action through initiatives like the semiconductor mission.Semiconductors are the building blocks of modern technology and a foundation of economic power. They power Artificial Intelligence (AI), telecommunications, electric mobility, defence and advanced manufacturing.  In the past two years, the global semiconductor market has grown by more than 20 per cent. 12 semiconductor projects have been approved across six states in the country, with investments commitments of more than one lakh 64 thousand crore rupees. Addressing SEMICON India 2026 in New Delhi, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said that India is taking every step needed to become a preferred destination for the semiconductor industry.Talking exclusively to Akashvani News, IT Expert Prasoon Sharma said India’s semiconductor journey is no longer a story of aspiration but is becoming a story of execution.India’s semiconductor journey has evolved from building strategic capabilities to creating a broader domestic ecosystem. These efforts are positioning India to participate across the semiconductor value chain.

. The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) has constituted a special team to investigate a security incident concerning eMudhra’s Public Key Infrastructure (PKI). The Ministry said that it has taken serious note of the reported incident, saying that its impact on Indian websites and applications has been very limited and for a very short duration.The Ministry further stated that Digital Signature Certificates and eSign services regulated by the Controller of Certifying Authorities (CCA) remain completely unaffected by this incident. The Ministry said that eMudhra operates in two distinct areas, which are related to the issuance of Digital Signature Certificates and eSign services and the issuance of digital certificates trusted by major browsers and operating systems, used to secure websites, software and online communications.The Ministry also mentioned that another function is international in nature and operates under a global trust framework. It is governed by international standards and subject to independent audits, including WebTrust audits conducted by BDO International Limited. The Ministry said that the reported security incident pertains to this only and it is not involved in its audit.The Ministry said it is engaged with all the stakeholders to resolve this incident at the earliest and the Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) has also issued an advisory in connection with the incident, including the mitigation measures.
. In the Indian bullion market today, 24 carat gold was 1.2 per cent down at 1 lakh 44 thousand 105 rupees per 10 grams. Silver lost 0.9 per cent to 2 lakh 6 thousand 783 rupees per kilogram.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has completed 25 years in public service, a journey defined by the mantra of Jan Seva Se Desh Seva, and a relentless commitment that continues. Guided by this vision for Seva and Sushasan, the Government has been ceaselessly working towards achieving the goal of a Viksit Bharat by 2047. Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives. Today, in our special series, we bring you an instance of how this vision has been translated into action through initiatives like Jan Bhagidari.Jan Bhagidari, which means public participation, is a core governance model under Narendra Modi government. Schemes that utilize the Jan Bhagidari model include Swachh Bharat  Mission, Catch the Rain, Vocal for Local, and Pradhan Mantri TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan. Citizens in India had traditionally been treated as passive beneficiaries of government schemes. Jan Bhagidari has brought a change to this and fostered local ownership and behavioural change in people. Prime Minister Narendra Modi regularly highlights Jan Bhagidari as a core pillar of nation-building through his monthly radio program, Mann Ki Baat. In Mann Ki Baat  last month, Prime Minister Modi again highlighted Jan Bhagidari as a driving force for social change, urging citizens to join collective movements like the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyan.Talking to Akashvani News, Shivendra Singh, a resident of Prayagraj, spoke about how he and his family and friends believe in Jan Bhagidari and go Vocal For Local during festive seasons.Participation has now become ownership of transformation happening around the country, with the people becoming stakeholders in national development.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has completed 25 years in public service, a journey defined by the mantra of Jan Seva Se Desh Seva, and a relentless commitment that continues. Guided by this vision for Seva and Sushasan, the Government has been ceaselessly working towards achieving the goal of a Viksit Bharat by 2047. Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives. Today, in our special series, we bring you an instance of how this vision has been translated into action through initiatives like Give It Up Campaign.The Give It Up campaign, launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in 2015, has encouraged consumers to voluntarily give up their LPG subsidies. Under the campaign, more than one crore 13 lakh LPG consumers have voluntarily surrendered their LPG subsidy. The savings helped provide LPG connections to poor households under the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana, particularly benefiting rural women who relied on firewood and cow dung for cooking. The government has provided over ten crore 56 lakh free LPG connections under the scheme to adult women from poor households across the country. Addressing the Delhi Economics Conclave in 2015, Prime Minister Modi highlighted that the Give It Up movement inspired the citizens to come together to help underprivileged families acquire clean fuel.A resident of Uttar Pradesh, Sanju Devi said that the gas stove has made cooking much more convenient and freed her from exposure to smoke.The Give It Up campaign has promoted a sense of social responsibility among citizens and has supported the government’s efforts to ensure clean cooking fuel access for all.
. In the Indian bullion market today, 24 carat gold was 0.3 per cent up at 1,46,426 rupees per 10 grams. Silver surged over 1.2 per cent to 2,10,918 rupees per kilogram.

. The Delhi government has proposed capping the number of e-rickshaws in the national capital at 2.5 lakh. In this regard, the government has placed the draft E-Rickshaw Policy in the public domain for one month, inviting suggestions and feedback from stakeholders before finalising the regulatory framework.The proposed policy aims to streamline e-rickshaw operations, improve road safety and strengthen last-mile connectivity while addressing traffic congestion. Delhi Transport Minister Dr Pankaj Kumar Singh said that the government is considering a cap of 2.5 lakh e-rickshaws in Delhi, with mandatory compliance certification, fitness requirements, valid licensing and vehicle identification to ensure that only eligible vehicles operate on city roads. He said that the policy is being formulated after careful consideration to balance commuters’ needs with the requirement for disciplined traffic management.The Minister added that the proposed framework will also seek to address overloading and ensure compliance with prescribed passenger capacity, fitness and safety standards. Dr Singh said that following consultation and finalisation of the policy, the government proposes to initiate its implementation process within 90 days.

. Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla paid tribute to freedom fighter Ashfaqulla Khan on his birth anniversary today. In a social media post, Mr. Birla said that Ashfaqulla Khan, a hero of the Kakori Action, wrote such an indelible chapter of sacrifice for the nation. He added that his sacrifice continues to inspire millions of people even today.Meanwhile, Home Minister Amit Shah today paid tribute to freedom fighter Ashfaqulla Khan on his birth anniversary. In a social media post, Mr Shah said that Ashfaqulla Khan, together with Chandrashekhar Azad, Ram Prasad Bismil, and other revolutionaries, openly challenged British rule through the Kakori Train Action. He added that the tortures inflicted by the British could not sway him from his principles and his resolve for the freedom of India, and ultimately, he embraced the gallows with a smile. The Minister noted that his indomitable courage and supreme sacrifice will forever inspire future generations to remain dedicated to the nation.

US President Donald Trump has described preventing Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons as one of the major achievements of his administration, claiming that Tehran would have already used such weapons had Washington not intervened. Speaking to the media, Trump said the decision required courage, adding that no previous US President has been willing to take similar action. His remarks came a day after Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi accused Washington of using Tehran’s nuclear programme as a pretext for opposing Iran’s regional policies.

. India’s double Olympic medallist P V Sindhu survived a scare from Thailand’s world No. 26 Supanida Katethong to advance in the French Open Super 750 badminton tournament in Paris yesterday. The former world champion and world No. 1 battled for an hour and four minutes before prevailing 21-14, 8-21, 23-21 in a gruelling encounter.Sindhu started strongly, taking the opening game 21-14, but Katethong fought back in the second, dominating the rallies to level the match with a commanding 21-8 win. The decider proved to be a tense affair, with both players fighting for every point. Sindhu eventually held her nerve in the closing stages to edge past the Thai shuttler 23-21 and seal her place in the next round. The next clash is scheduled for today.

. The country’s foreign exchange reserves declined over 8.5 billion US dollars (USD) to 726 billion US dollars during the week ended 9th of October. According to Reserve Bank of India data, Foreign currency assets, the largest component of the reserves, dropped by 7.1 billion dollars to 597.6 billion dollars during the week. Gold reserves dropped by 1.3 billion dollars to 105 billion dollars. Special Drawing Rights fell by 109 million dollars to 18.5 billion dollars. The country’s reserve position with the International Monetary Fund dipped 10 million dollars to 4.78 billion dollars.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has completed 25 years in public service, a journey defined by the mantra of Jan Seva Se Desh Seva, and a relentless commitment that continues. Guided by this vision for Seva and Sushasan, the Government has been ceaselessly working towards achieving the goal of a Viksit Bharat by 2047. Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives. Today, in our special series, we bring you an instance of how this vision has been translated into action through initiatives aimed at removing the colonial mindset.The history of modern India is deeply entangled with two centuries of British colonialism, and decades after Independence. Over the past few years, the Government has slowly been steering India, away from these vestiges of British rule. Addressing the nation from the Red Fort on the 76th Independence Day in 2022, the Prime Minister outlined five resolutions, or Panch Pran for the next 25 years. Elaborating on the second Praan, he said, in no part of citizens’ existence, not even in the deepest corners of mind or habits should there be any ounce of slavery.In a concerted effort to free the country from its colonial legacy and promote a distinct Indian identity, the Government has undertaken a series of initiatives across various sectors. the historic Rajpath in New Delhi was renamed Kartavya Path and inaugurated by the Prime Minister in 2022.  Similarly, a grand statue of freedom fighter Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose was installed near India Gate, which has replaced the statue of King George the Fifth. The Indian Navy also adopted a new ensign in 2022, replacing the earlier design that featured the Saint George’s Cross. The Government has merged the Rail Budget with the Union Budget from budget year 2017-18, ending a practice dating back to 1924. BJP leader Ram Madhav has said that restoring India’s cultural and civilizational identity is a symbol of self-respect. He added that decolonisation is the real patriotism that is happening today.The Government has further sought to revive literature banned during British rule, with the National Archives of India compiling a catalogue of banned poems, writings and publications from the freedom struggle. In addition, more than 1,500 obsolete laws have been repealed in recent years as part of efforts to simplify governance and remove outdated legal provisions.These initiatives reflect the Government’s stated commitment to building a confident, self-reliant India rooted in its cultural heritage and national values.

. In the forex market today, the rupee appreciated by 46 paise to close at 94 rupees and 47 paise against the US dollar.The dollar index, which indicates US dollar’s strength against a basket of six other leading currencies, was trading at 101.68 in intra-day trade.

. India achieved a spectacular podium sweep at the Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, as Sachin Sarjerao Khilari, Mohd. Yasser, and Parveen clinched gold, silver, and bronze, respectively, in the men’s shot put F46 event today.Khilari led the Indian triumph with a record-breaking throw of 15.87 metres. Yasser secured the silver medal with a best throw of 15.06 metres, while Parveen claimed bronze with 14.94 metres. These athletes also recorded their Season Best performances, making it a memorable clean sweep for India on the podium.India’s Praveen Kumar won gold in the men’s high jump T44/64 with a Games record, while Banti clinched silver in the same event in Aichi Nagoya, Japan today. Praveen sailed over 2.05m to win the gold while Banti produced a personal best of 1.92m to take the silver. Temurbek Giyazov of Uzbekistan was third with 1.86m.Ayush Verma also won gold medal in the men’s shot put F53 event today, adding a second medal to his tally. Ayush produced a throw of 8.16m in his fifth attempt to take the top spot. Alireza Hemami of Iran was second with 8.09m while Makhambet Serikkaliyev of Kazakhstan finished third with 6.81m. F53 is for field athletes who have movement affected to a high degree in the trunk and legs and hand grip affected to a low level.Teenage Indian pair of  para-archers Sheetal Devi and Payal Nag clinched a silver medal after losing in the compound women’s doubles final today. Sheetal, who was born without arms, and Payal, a quadruple amputee, went down 141-150 to the Chinese duo of Xu Xueqing and Zhao Jing. Sheetal had won a silver medal in this event in the last edition of the Games partnering Sarita Devi.In the men’s 100m T35 event Anubhav Choudhary secured Bronze medal. He clocked a personal best of 12.72 seconds to win the medal. Rakeshbhai Bhatt also won bronze medal in men’s 100 meter T37 event.

. Minister of Ports, Shipping and Waterways Sarbananda Sonowal said that all 21 Indian crew members, along with the rest of the crew on board a Kuwait-flagged oil product tanker, are safe after the vessel was struck by an unknown projectile.In a social media post, Mr Sonowal said the incident occurred yesterday while the ship M/T AL DASMA was transiting through the Strait of Hormuz. He said that India is closely monitoring the situation and remains in contact with the ship management company to ensure the ongoing security and well-being of the seafarers.

. India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast heavy to very heavy rainfall over Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal during the next three days. According to IMD, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Kerala and Mahe are expected to experience heavy rainfall today.MetDepartment has also predicted thunderstorms with lightning and gusty winds over East Rajasthan, Konkan, Goa, Lakshadweep, Madhya Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh today. Similar weather conditions are likely to prevail over Odisha, Rayalaseema, Telangana, Coastal Karnataka and South Interior Karnataka for the day.For Delhi, the Weather Agency has forecast a clear sky today.

. Bringing festive cheer to Dalal Street, both the National Stock Exchange and the Bombay Stock Exchange will host the special Diwali Muhurat Trading session on November 8 this year. According to the circular released by the exchanges, the markets will open at 2:20 PM and close at 3:30 PM. The Muhurat trading marks the auspicious beginning of the new Samvat year, as investors make their symbolic trades for prosperity and good fortune. All trades executed during this session will carry normal settlement obligations.

. At the Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, India have won a total of 23 medals so far, including five gold, eight silver, and 10 bronze. Indian para-athlete Deepthi Jeevanji clinched gold in the women’s 400m T20 event, setting a new Games record with a time of 56.36 seconds. Her victory marked India’s fifth gold medal at the competition. In another fixture, India’s Shrishti Arora marked her debut at the Asian Para Games 2026 with a bronze medal in the women’s 10m air pistol SH1 event, while Jehan Dorab Madan also won a bronze medal in Para Table Tennis Men’s Singles Class 1.

. Global crude oil prices rose today. Brent crude was trading half a per cent up at 106 US dollars and 46 cents per barrel. West Texas Intermediate crude was trading 0.2 per cent up at 98 US dollars and 18 cents per barrel, at the time of writing this report.

. The United States has ordered non-emergency government employees and their family members to leave Saudi Arabia amid growing security threats from Iran-aligned Houthi rebels in Yemen. In a social media post, State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott said the decision followed increasing Houthi attacks on Saudi civilian airports and critical infrastructure, causing casualties and travel disruptions.The move comes amid escalating regional tensions following the US-Israeli war on Iran, which has disrupted global energy trade and affected Gulf economies. The US Embassy in Riyadh recently warned of possible further Houthi attacks after deadly strikes, including on the Saudi capital’s airport.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will hold talks with Poland’s counterpart, Donald Tusk, in New Delhi today. Both leaders will review the entire spectrum of bilateral relations during their talks and also exchange views on regional and global issues of mutual interest. Several agreements are expected to be signed after the talks.Prime Minister Tusk is being accompanied by Minister of Finance and Economy, Andrzej Domanski, and a large business delegation. This is his second visit to India in his capacity as the Prime Minister of Poland. He first visited India during his earlier tenure in 2010. Prime Minister Tusk has also visited New Delhi in 2017 for the India-EU Summit in his capacity as President of the European Council.Prime Minister Tusk will also travel to Bengaluru during his visit, where he will engage with various business stakeholders, including those from the IT and space sectors.India-Poland bilateral relations were elevated to a Strategic Partnership during the visit of Prime Minister Modi to Poland in August 2024. Both countries celebrated 70 years of diplomatic relations in 2024. Bilateral trade was pegged at over 6 billion dollars in 2025. Poland is India’s largest trading and investment partner in Central and Eastern Europe. Indian investments in Poland are valued at over 3 billion dollars. Around 3500 Indian students are pursuing higher education in Poland.Poland is home to a strong Indian diaspora of over 30 thousand. The visit will provide the opportunity to further strengthen the India-Poland Strategic Partnership and advance cooperation in areas of mutual interest, including trade and investment, defence, emerging technologies, renewable energy, education, culture and people-to-people ties. It would also serve to deepen the India-EU strategic partnership.

. India has issued a safety advisory for its nationals residing in or travelling to France, urging them to remain vigilant amid violent protests, localised curfews and possible disruptions to public transport. In a statement, the Indian Embassy in France advised Indian citizens to avoid large gatherings and areas witnessing demonstrations and to follow instructions issued by local authorities.The Embassy also asked travellers to monitor official updates and check for transport disruptions. It advised those planning trips to or within France to remain in contact with their airlines and travel agencies for information on schedule changes. Indian Embassy has provided emergency contact details +33 6 48 34 00 and +33 7 43 16 25 59 in case of any emergency.The advisory comes amid nationwide protests in France. The French government has pledged to take all necessary measures to prevent further violence during fresh demonstrations scheduled for the 24th of this month.Earlier, President Macron said that the government will use all available legal means to prevent a recurrence of violent incidents. However, he said that a state of emergency is not necessary at this stage, though it can be considered if required.

. The India Meteorological Department has issued an orange-coloured warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall over Kerala, Mahe, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal today. Heavy rainfall is also expected over Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep and South Interior Karnataka till Sunday. The Met Department has predicted thunderstorms accompanied by lightning over Andhra Pradesh, Interior and Coastal Karnataka, Telangana and West Madhya Pradesh during the next three days. India continued its strong performance at the Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan today, as India’s medal tally rose to 35, including nine gold, eleven silver and fifteen bronze.Indians swept all three medals in the men’s discus throw F44/64 event. Devender Kumar clinched gold with a throw of 49.71 m, while Rakesh took silver with 49.35 m.India’s Pranav Soorma won gold in the men’s discus throw F51/52/53 event, scoring 932 points and also setting a new Asian record of 11.66 metres in the F51 event, while Ram Ratan Singh clinched silver with a throw of 10.35 metres, scoring 809 points in the same event.In the Women’s 200m T12 final, Simran clinched gold, clocking 24.80 seconds, setting a new Games record. Tejalben Damor also secured bronze, clocking 25.23 seconds in the same event.Indian para-athlete Deepthi Jeevanji won gold in the women’s 400-metre T20 event, setting a new Games record with a time of 56.36 seconds.In Powerlifting, Ashok won silver in the men’s 65-kilogram category with a lift of 192 kilograms. The World Bank Group has launched its first comprehensive digital strategy, placing artificial intelligence, affordable internet access and job creation at the centre of its development agenda as 1.2 billion young people prepare to enter the workforce in developing countries over the next 10 to 15 years. Announced in Seoul today, the strategy brings together the institution’s public and private sector capabilities to help developing economies expand digital connectivity, improve access to technology and create employment opportunities. World Bank Group President Ajay Banga said the initiative would focus on practical applications of technology, particularly affordable artificial intelligence tools that can improve productivity and public services. The strategy identifies digital technology as a means of improving productivity and expanding employment in infrastructure, energy, agriculture, healthcare, tourism and manufacturing. The World Bank said more than two billion people remained offline globally in 2025.

. The Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship 2026 will be held at the Veer Savarkar Sports Complex in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, from October 23 to 31. Thirteen teams will compete in the men’s kabaddi tournament, while the women’s competition will feature 10 teams in the inaugural edition. Both competitions of the inaugural Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship will feature a group stage followed by semi-finals on October 30 and the gold medal matches on October 31.The men’s Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship 2026 will feature 13 teams divided into two groups, with seven teams in Group A and six in Group B. The Indian men’s kabaddi team, led by captain Surjeet Singh and vice-captain Naveen Kumar, will compete in Group A alongside Nigeria, Malaysia, Uganda, England, Tanzania and Sri Lanka. Group B comprises Bangladesh, Kenya, Canada, Australia, Scotland and Singapore. Each team will face the other sides in its group once, with the competition progressing to the semi-finals on October 30. The men’s final will be played on October 31.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has completed 25 years in public service, a journey defined by the mantra of Jan Seva Se Desh Seva, and a relentless commitment that continues. Guided by this vision for Seva and Sushasan, the Government has been ceaselessly working towards achieving the goal of a Viksit Bharat by 2047. Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives. Today, in our special series, we bring you an instance of how this vision has been translated into action through initiatives like the Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam.In 2023, Parliament passed the Constitution (One Hundred and Sixth Amendment) Act – Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam, marking a historic milestone in its national journey to foster equitable representation of women in public life at all levels of the federal structure. This landmark legislation reserves one-third of all seats for women in the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies. In his Independence Day address this year, Prime Minister Narendra Modi appealed to all political parties to end decades of delay and swiftly implement the one-third legislative reservation for women in Parliament and state assemblies.Talking to Akashvani News, Rajya Sabha MP from Bihar Dharamshila Gupta said that through this act, the Modi government has paved the way for half of the country’s population to play a decisive role in political and policy-making processes.The Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam, once implemented, women’s representation will rise substantially in the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies. It is a decisive step towards empowering India’s Nari Shakti with a stronger voice in decision-making and a greater role in shaping the nation’s future.

Minister of Cooperation Amit Shah today paid tribute to Tribhuvandas Patel, the pioneer of the White Revolution and the architect of the cooperative movement, on his birth anniversary.In a social media post, Mr Shah highlighted that under the guidance of Sardar Patel, Tribhuvandas Patel sowed the seed in 1946 for the Kheda District Cooperative Milk Producers’ Union, which has now grown into the mighty banyan tree of Amul, becoming the foundation of prosperity for over 36 lakh farmers and lakhs of sisters. He said that in his name, the country’s first National Cooperative University, the Tribhuvandas Cooperative University, has been established in Anand, Gujarat, which provides trained leadership to the cooperative sector. The Minister noted that his life and dedication to cooperation will forever inspire the resolve to realise Prosperity through Cooperation.
